title: How to choose my placement supports?
description: How to make your employee or retirement savings grow according to your objectives, your investment horizons? http://www.epargne-retraite-entreprises.bnpparibas.com/

asr.full_text: Why is it more risky ? Hi ! Thanks to you , still me, Ernest. Let's talk about earning a living as a tax office. You will see it is not as difficult as it seems. Lynette decided to choose by herself her financial statements among those chosen by her company. Which is up to him to choose some statements are more risky than others but they provide potential risks to be had. The AMF has set a ladder of risk around you to guide to make the most of your choices, from 1 to 7. The closer you get to 7, the higher is the risk level. There are no secrets in the same basket, so we need some wisdom! Don't ask yourself a good questions before investing. First of all, what are my goals? To save for a retirement guarantee? To acquire a home? Then, when should i need my savings, in 1 year, 5 years, 10 years or more? Finally, what risk level would I be ready to take on my capital? Little? Much? or nothing at all! you need not to make white hair before age, make your choices according to your temperament. After your answers, it will be easy to choose your placement supports. Generally speaking, for a very long range of placement beyond 10 years, shares offer a higher possible rise. In the medium term, Fonds or slightly diversified shares carry a higher increase potential. Under-the-ground terms, compulsory or slightly diversifying funds play a less challenging role. If you need the money on the short term, places like Le Monétaire will probably be more reassuring. The goal is more to preserve the capital than having high performances. At all times, you can change the bank account or get it managed differently. The role of bank accounts Find out your company in person it is possible to change its support or to differentially allocate its savings. Then sign up to your company to find out about the support she is offering.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents employer retirement-savings education about aligning investment choices with personal goals, timing, and risk tolerance. Its discussion of shares, bonds, and monetary funds describes different risk levels and potential performance rather than rapid or guaranteed returns, and it directs viewers to consult their company about available support.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary context is an educational and operational explanation of how to choose retirement-savings investment supports using goals, time horizon and risk tolerance.
